title: A Reel in Fifteen Seconds (Claude motion designer)
summary: A 15 s code-made motion reel on a warm paper/vermilion/ink system. Opens on paper with a serif-italic note 'a reel, in fifteen seconds' and a red ball bouncing with squash-and-stretch arcs and labels; then vermilion full-bleed 'I MAKE / MOVE' with mask-stagger heavy caps where the O becomes a white ball; a dense Bauhaus tile pattern; a chrome blob behind outlined 'FORM'; a particle galaxy that morphs into the word 'flow'; a paper-white data dashboard; a glitched 'NOISE'; and a serif 'Claude.' end card with spaced caps 'MOTION DESIGNER'. HUD labels on every frame (01/08 TIMING & SPACING, MASKS · STAGGER · VARIABLE AXES).
fit_reason: Fine craft and an elegant paper/vermilion palette, but it's a technique showreel with no product or message; borrow the end card and data scene only.

palette.mood: warm paper and vermilion with ink black; Bauhaus cobalt/ochre in the pattern scene; dark interludes #08080c

typography.display: ultra-heavy grotesk caps (Druk / Archivo Black) + high-contrast serif italic (Instrument Serif / Editorial New) + spaced small caps
typography.size_behaviour: huge full-bleed caps for type beats; small italic serif notes; very tiny mono HUD
typography.notes: End card: 'Claude.' serif italic with vermilion dot, thin rule, 'M O T I O N  D E S I G N E R' widely tracked caps. Data numbers in bold grotesk with serif-italic captions ('frames, zero keyframes').

text_animation: mask-stagger: heavy caps slide up out of masks letter-by-letter, previous word knocked out
letter replaced by a physical ball (O in MOVE)
outline repeating text bands scroll behind a hero word
particles assemble into a script word
serif wordmark writes in with blur then rule draws under
motion: squash-and-stretch ball with dotted trajectory and labels
14,000-particle curl-noise galaxy swirl morphing to text
bar chart and donut gauge count up
transitions: fade to paper for end card
graphic_elements: HUD frame (title, timecode, chapter 01/08 label, scrubber)
signature_moves: serif italic note + labelled squash-and-stretch diagram as opener
vermilion full-bleed heavy caps with mask stagger and a ball replacing a letter

best_segments.what: Three-dot merge into serif 'Claude.' end card with drawn rule and spaced caps

recreate.how: Remotion/GSAP for type and HUD; canvas/WebGL for particles and blob.
recreate.prompt: Warm paper and vermilion motion reel: labelled squash-and-stretch ball, full-bleed vermilion heavy caps sliding out of masks, particles forming a script word, ending on a serif italic wordmark with a red dot and widely tracked caps.
